answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 15198 Country: Pakistan Title: Kia nafli roza mai bhool k kuch eat kar liya jaye to kia roza tooth jata hai? Question: Kia nafli roza mai bhool k kuch eat kar liya jaye to kia roza tooth jata hai? Answer ID: 15198 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1326/1326=M/1430) The sawm (fast) is not nullified by eating forgetfully, whether it is Ramdhan sawm or nafl (optional). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
